articles.title: Nvidia forms 37-member AI security alliance without OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
articles.snippet: The chipmaker and 36 other companies say defenders need AI they can run themselves. Major AI players OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not among them.

articles.title: Bitmine buys more ether as Tom Lee says rising ETH/BTC ratio points to stronger crypto prices
articles.snippet: The Ethereum treasury company added nearly 10,000 ETH while expanding its stock buyback, citing ether outperforming bitcoin is sending a bullish signal.

articles.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy boosted cash reserve to $3.75 billion, repurchased $25 million of STRC
articles.snippet: The company last week raised $544.5 million in cash via sales of its common stock.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong criticizes crypto startups that rebrand to AI
articles.snippet: Armstrong said blockchain technology acts as a general-purpose infrastructure that will underpin future automation rather than competing with it.

articles.title: Cloud data firm Storj files for Chapter 11, extending a week of crypto failures. Token slides 16%
articles.snippet: The decentralized data storage company says operations continue and proposes that token holders take equity in the restructured business — an unusual arrangement in bankruptcy.
